paginate violates the stated rule: it returns items[start:start + size + 1], which can yield up to size + 1 items instead of AT MOST `size`.
apply_discount uses `total > 100`, so a total of exactly 100 does not receive the 10% discount, violating the rule that discounts apply to totals of AT LEAST 100.
